svg.aria-label: telos: One workbench, and packets that recompute their own claims. An eye drawn in nested fine contours, its iris a ring of short radial lines around a dark pupil with a glowing rim. Five small rings sit on the eye's edge; one is dashed and marked UNVERIFIABLE.
